document.title: PMK 8/2026: Perubahan PMK 228/2017 (data dan informasi perpajakan)

delta.note: This regulation amends PMK 228/PMK.03/2017 on the types of tax-related data and information that government agencies, institutions, associations and other parties must submit to the DGT, and on the submission procedures. It covers notifications on data utilization, data requests when the data received is insufficient, and delegation of authority. These are purely administrative and data-reporting matters. It does not change any value, rate, threshold, deduction, or calculation step for PPh 21 on permanent employees.

quotes.quote: Dalam hal data dan informasi yang diterima tidak mencukupi, Direktur Jenderal Pajak berwenang menghimpun data dan informasi yang berkaitan dengan perpajakan
Instansi pemerintah, lembaga, asosiasi, dan pihak lain wajib memberikan data dan informasi yang berkaitan dengan perpajakan kepada Direktorat Jenderal Pajak.
